name: iam:PassRole + ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition + ecs:RunTask
description: Register an ECS task definition with a privileged role and run it on Fargate to execute attacker-controlled container commands with the role's permissions
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target role ARN must be in the Resource section
Must have permission to register new task definitions
Must have permission to run tasks in the target cluster

additional.description: Monitor service status and verify service creation
List tasks in the cluster to get task ARN
Find VPCs for Fargate network configuration
Find subnets for Fargate network configuration

admin: A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com with administrative permissions
lateral: A role must exist that trusts ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com

references.title: Weaponizing AWS ECS Task Definitions to Steal Credentials From Running Containers

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to the ECS task (must trust ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com) [auto]

options.name: CLUSTER_NAME
options.description: Name of an existing ECS cluster to run the task on (defaults to 'default' cluster)

options.name: SUBNET_ID
options.description: Subnet ID for Fargate network configuration (will auto-detect from default VPC if not specified)

options.name: TASK_FAMILY
options.description: ECS task definition family name (auto-generated if not specified)

options.name: CONTAINER_IMAGE
options.description: Container image to use for the task

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Deregister the task definition after execution

payloads.name: backdoor/attach-policy
payloads.description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an IAM user or role via ECS task container command
